Annie Anderson

Founder of the Pranaclimb Methodology

Independent Researcher · Breathwork Specialist · Cornwall

Annie Anderson is an independent researcher, breathwork specialist, and lifelong climber with over 30 years of worldwide experience. Creator of the Pranaclimb Methodology — a field-adapted system using BR, RPE and HRR₆₀ to track performance thresholds in real-time. Published on SportRxiv and ResearchGate.

Based on the sea cliffs of Cornwall. Her philosophy — live, love life every day — carried her through three years of Stage 4 Renal Cell Carcinoma and surgery.

Pranaclimb Ltd

Annie Anderson is a breathwork specialist, independent researcher, and lifelong climber. Pranaclimb weaves together over 35 years of climbing, 25+ years of yoga, meditation, and breathwork, and a decade of independent research into breathing, anatomy & physiology, psychology, neurobiology, and performance science.

Annie is a qualified SPA/RCI Rock Climbing Instructor (1998) and Registered Yoga Teacher RYT 200 (2012).

Pranaclimb Ltd holds full professional indemnity and public liability insurance with Insure4Sport (Underwritten by Aviva Insurance Limited).
